title: Botany seed-reference identity and scream mutation
acceptance_criteria: Seed identity is an opaque stable reference with ID-only equality; its copy/codec preserves a detached current immutable snapshot, while genetic values remain immutable and unchanged.

COW occurs before valid genetic mutation effects, but only after full batch admission/validation; invalid batches have no COW identity side effects and sub-unit soil solutions still obey the 25-level boundary.

A unique seed remains unique through single-output non-repeat harvest, one-packet extraction, and replanting of the same cell; a retained reference handle observes in-place changes and identity replacement leaves its old captured cell stable. This does not establish a swab gameplay consumer.
Repeat and multi-output harvest mark the source shared only at commit; later mutation COWs, leaving prior references stable. Extraction marks shared only when producing multiple packets.
Carrier and packet genetic reads use the shared effective-genetics reader; current genetics never regenerate produce chemistry or refill depleted produce.
Species replacement creates a new identity even when the resulting species ID is unchanged; pollen crossing remains unimplemented.

Resolved scream default/toggle is copied, inherited, and codec-preserved. Server-tray audio uses the exact eleven reused clips and -10 dB gain, only after successful manual or automatic source commit, including the zero-output accepted branch; stale denial and failed publication produce no output/audio. Audio consumes no gameplay RNG.
Report pollen swab assets/request and capture/cross gameplay as open; do not claim complete pollen behavior, full catalog, full showcase, connected visual review, full suite, or owner acceptance.
Main, JVM-test, and native sources compile and runtime jar is produced.
manual_steps: Existing `/ms14 botany_fixture` is partial and does not expose every mutation. Seed-reference internals are not a complete pollen-item or cross/showcase scenario; do not claim one or ask for repeated gas testing.

The existing fixture has no confirmed enabled-scream station or current owner scenario for M6. Manual scream inspection remains an explicit missing boundary until a suitable fixture exists; full sprint owner review remains outstanding.
